topic: Choso felt Yuji's impending end in Shibuya, then stepped in front of Sukuna's flame in Shinjuku and was thanked before the end
title: Choso Felt Yuji's Ending Coming Before Yuji Did
description: Choso's cursed technique lets him sense his brothers changing from any distance, so he saw Yuji's end coming before anyone. In Shinjuku, he stepped in front of Sukuna's flame to shield Yuji. Is Choso Yuji's brother for real, or just Kenjaku's experiment?
comment: Was Choso Yuji's real brother, or only Kenjaku's experiment in a family costume? Pick a side.

lines.text: Choso could feel Yuji's ending coming before Yuji ever did.

shot.fallback: dark haired sorcerer staring at a younger boy, anime style

lines.text: His cursed technique lets him sense his brothers changing, from any distance.

shot.fallback: pale sorcerer with dark cursed energy, anime style

lines.text: So when Sukuna lined up his flame in Shinjuku, Choso didn't hesitate.

shot.fallback: king of curses raising a blazing attack, anime style

lines.text: He stepped in front of Yuji and took the hit himself.

shot.fallback: sorcerer stepping in front of a blazing attack, anime style

lines.text: Think about that for a second.

shot.fallback: sorcerer frozen in firelight, anime style

lines.text: The enemy who swore revenge is now the one shielding him.

shot.fallback: former enemy shielding a young fighter, anime style

lines.text: Before the end, they thanked each other for being brothers.

shot.fallback: two sorcerers sharing a final look, anime style

lines.text: Most fans call that a plot twist. I think it's the real answer.

shot.fallback: two brothers in a dark courtyard, anime style

lines.text: Choso didn't need the family tie to be real.

shot.fallback: sorcerer standing tall in soft light, anime style

lines.text: He made it real by choosing it, one move at a time.

shot.fallback: sorcerer choosing a path in the dark, anime style

lines.text: Yuji was the brother Choso always sensed, and the one who never got to answer.

shot.fallback: young fighter reaching out in the dark, anime style

lines.text: And that's the gap fans keep arguing about.

shot.fallback: two sorcerers facing a dark horizon, anime style

lines.text: So why did Choso step in, if he could feel the ending coming?

shot.fallback: sorcerer in a glowing storm, anime style

self_check.hook: Opens on Choso feeling Yuji's ending coming, then names the Shinjuku flame in the second line.
self_check.loop: The last line asks why Choso stepped in if he could feel the ending, which leads straight back into the first line.
